rationale: The clause matches RBI (Commercial Banks - Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025 (rbi-13141), which requires the KYC policy to be approved by the Board of Directors or a committee to which the Board has delegated power, and lists the same four key elements (Customer Acceptance Policy, Risk Management, CIP, Monitoring of Transactions).

evidence.quote: (1) The bank shall have a KYC policy. The Board of Directors of the bank, or any committee to which the Board has delegated power, shall duly approve the KYC policy.
(2) The KYC policy shall include following four key elements: (i) Customer Acceptance Policy; (ii) Risk Management (iii) Customer Identification Procedures (CIP); and (iv) Monitoring of Transactions
